title: Constraint
description: Enforcement rule in the Shapes Specification. Defines a verifiable condition that shapes must satisfy — covering code style, architecture boundaries, testing requirements, or any other governance rule.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this constraint.

description.description: Prose description of what this constraint enforces and why.

rule.description: The concrete rule statement that must hold. Should be precise enough to verify.

profile.description: Reference to the governance profile that controls this constraint's lifecycle and field requirements.

version.description: Semantic version string tracking the evolution of this constraint.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this constraint (e.g. proposed, canonical, superseded).

intent.description: Structured declaration of what this constraint is meant to achieve and why.

realization.description: Bindings that map this constraint to concrete enforcement artifacts (lint configs, CI scripts, etc.).

evidence.description: Verification records proving that this constraint is being enforced.

provenance.description: Origin and authorship records for this constraint.

amendment_log.description: Ordered list of Amendment IDs that have modified this constraint.

parents.description: References to parent constraints in a constraint hierarchy.

children.description: Child constraints nested under this constraint.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to this constraint. Profile field declarations may constrain which keys are expected.

ConstraintChildRef.title: ConstraintChildRef
ConstraintChildRef.description: Reference to a child constraint, either by ID or as a fully inline constraint definition.

constraint.description: The child constraint, specified as either a numeric ID reference or a full inline Constraint.

role.description: The role this child plays within its parent (e.g. 'sub-rule', 'refinement').

reason.description: Explanation of why this child exists under this parent.

ConstraintRef.title: ConstraintRef
ConstraintRef.description: Untagged union: either a numeric Constraint ID for referencing an existing constraint, or a full inline Constraint definition.

oneOf.description: Numeric ID referencing an existing constraint defined elsewhere.
Full inline Constraint definition nested directly in the parent.
